purpose: Run the three-assistant T5 workflow after correcting the observed Claude read-only adapter interaction, then compare it with a fresh solo Codex control.

supersedes.reason: The first attempt stopped before the paid worker because Claude plan mode attempted to save its review to a plan file through a deliberately unavailable Write tool. No task file changed and no OpenRouter call began.

baseline.resolution: Use the clean commit containing this v2 protocol, the v1 result, and the corrected workflow runner for both v2 runs.

adapter_change.available_tools_for_final_review: Read, Glob, Grep, plus only the frozen visible Bash command
adapter_change.prompt_change: Both Claude stages must return the review directly and must not create a plan file.
adapter_change.rationale: Keep both stages operationally read-only without invoking Claude Code's special plan-file workflow.

execution_order.command: npm run benchmark:workflow -- --task T5-review-queue --planner-model gpt-5.6-sol --reviewer-model claude-opus-5 --worker-model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3 --execute
npm run benchmark:run -- --assistant codex --task T5-review-queue --model gpt-5.6-sol --execute

budget.paid_v2_calls: Exactly one Kimi K3 implementation call; no paid repair or Qwen call.
budget.limit_policy: Do not increase a provider limit or enable Anthropic usage credits. Stop the paid lane after Kimi regardless of outcome.

acceptance.pass_rule: All visible and private checks pass, no read-only stage changes files, and no final path is out of scope.

rules: Use fresh ephemeral assistant sessions; do not reuse the v1 transcript or generated review as an input.
Use one isolated worktree for distributed stages and a separate worktree for the solo control.
Stop before the paid worker if either v2 planning stage fails, times out, returns no handoff, or changes the workspace.
Preserve worker-only and integrated patches separately, including failures and partial output.
Do not show private checks to any assistant and do not rerun inside this v2 block.
Report v1 as a harness failure and v2 separately; do not combine their elapsed time as though v1 were part of a successful workflow.
Report that Codex and Claude products saw the task in v1, although v2 uses fresh non-persistent sessions. Kimi and OpenCode did not see it in v1.
Use no human intervention, model substitution, dependency installation, account-limit change, or task-contract change.
